_note: Synthetic scout proposals for the local end-to-end proof. Sources are example.org placeholders; nothing here is published.

scout-a.title: Find the process squatting on port 8080: lsof, ss, and the flag everyone forgets
scout-a.brief: Three commands that answer 'address already in use' on macOS and Linux, why `lsof -i :8080` misses root-owned sockets without sudo, and the one time killing the PID was the wrong fix.

scout-a.title: direnv after six months: per-folder env vars without the shell-rc graveyard
scout-a.brief: An honest review of direnv on a laptop with nine projects: what `.envrc` saved, the `direnv allow` prompt we learned to respect, and where it leaked a token into a screen share.

scout-b.title: The cron job that ran twice: daylight saving time and the 02:30 schedule
scout-b.brief: Why a nightly 02:30 job ran twice in November and not at all in March, how to read the gap in syslog, and the UTC-only crontab rule that ended it.

scout-b.title: We let two scouts write the same backlog and they agreed on everything, including the id
scout-b.brief: A field note on the day two automated scouts each minted SRC-070 for different ideas, what the merge driver did about it, and why the fix was one writer, not a better lock.
